name: Peter Yahiayan
office: City of Santa Clarita, Member of the City Council, 4th District

items.text: His campaign says Peter Yahiayan is a real estate professional and small-business owner. His campaign notes that he also has experience in investment, property management and tax preparation. His California real estate salesperson license is currently restricted.

sentences.text: His campaign says Peter Yahiayan is a real estate professional and small-business owner.
His campaign notes that he also has experience in investment, property management and tax preparation.
His California real estate salesperson license is currently restricted.

items.text: According to his campaign, his priorities include linking growth to infrastructure, addressing traffic and emergency access, expanding housing options, ensuring accountable spending, and providing public safety with privacy oversight. In June 2026, he described the effects of the Bouquet Canyon Road closure on businesses and noted residents’ concerns about traffic congestion, emergency access and infrastructure as growth continues.
